python3 {HOME}/.claude/skills/rework-mr/scripts/threads.py propose t1 --iid 3 --says needs --summary "Miriam now prefers going back to \`queryKeys\` with aliasing on import" --why "Miriam reverses her own rename request: she now suggests every feature exports \`queryKeys\` and files that import two of them alias on import, so the \`commentKeys\` rename already pushed would be undone. Both names work, but reverting also means renaming \`discussionKeys\` in \`src/features/discussions/api/query-keys.ts\` and aliasing wherever both are imported, which is more churn than the current state, where each name is already unique and needs no alias. **Recommendation:** keep \`commentKeys\` / \`discussionKeys\` and reply asking Miriam to confirm, since she asked for that name in the first place and it avoids aliases." --outcome question --plan "Reply that \`commentKeys\` / \`discussionKeys\` is already pushed and needs no import aliases, and ask Miriam whether she still wants the switch back to \`queryKeys\`."

input.message: Stored a new proposal for t1 (needs, outcome question). Miriam's new comment reverses the agreed rename and asks to go back to `queryKeys`, so I did not use keep-plan. The proposal recommends keeping `commentKeys` / `discussionKeys` and asking her to confirm. No code was changed.
